segments.name: Commercial bank
segments.description: Commercial bank serving business owners and entrepreneurs with lending and deposit products, plus consumer lending.
segments.evidence: Therefore, management considers all financial service operations to be aggregated within one reportable operating segment, and evaluates financial performance on a company-wide basis using net income as reported on the consolidated statement of income.

revenueModel.text: Revenue comes mainly from interest on financial instruments, plus non-interest income and service charges on deposit accounts.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's single reportable segment, generates revenues primarily from interest income from financial instruments and non-interest income and service charges on deposit accounts.
